name: Kosovo
summary: Kosovo (uses the euro) taxes residents on foreign and Kosovo income at progressive rates of 0/8/10%. Capital gains are taxed at these rates (10% at the top). Dividends received by residents are exempt. No net wealth tax. There is no separate inheritance tax: inheritances and gifts between parents and children are exempt from income tax. No special regime for wealthy arrivals.

regimes.name: Ordinary tax residence
regimes.description: Ordinary residence; residents taxed on foreign and Kosovo-source income.
regimes.eligibility: Resident with a usual or main residence in Kosovo, 183+ days in the tax year, or centre of vital interests in Kosovo. Foreigners need a residence permit.

capital_gains.summary: Gains from selling capital assets, including real estate and securities, are taxable income at the ordinary PIT rates (0% up to EUR 3,000, 8% to EUR 5,400, 10% above). For a large gain the effective rate approaches 10%.

sources.title: Kosovo – Individual – Taxes on personal income

open_questions: Whether any holding-period or main-residence exemption applies was not verified.
capital_gains.rate_basis: Top PIT rate 10% applied to the whole gain (bands are tiny). Foreign gains in scope because residents are taxed on foreign-source income.
capital_gains.foreign_assets: Residents taxed on foreign and Kosovo-source income; 22 treaties.

dividends.summary: Dividends received by resident and non-resident taxpayers are exempt from PIT; there is no WHT on dividends.
open_questions: Whether foreign-source dividends are covered by the exemption was not confirmed from the PIT law.
dividends.rate_basis: PwC: 'Dividends received by resident and non-resident taxpayers are exempt from PIT.' Applied to foreign dividends as well (the exemption is not stated to be limited to Kosovo companies; low-to-medium confidence).
dividends.treaty_network: 22 treaties (Albania, Austria, Belgium, Croatia, Czech Republic, Finland, Germany, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, North Macedonia, Saudi Arabia, Slovenia, Switzerland, Turkey, UAE, UK).

wealth_tax.summary: Kosovo has no net wealth tax (PwC).
wealth_tax.property_tax_note: Municipal immovable property tax applies (rates not researched).

inheritance.summary: No separate inheritance tax. Inherited assets are handled under PIT: assets inherited by a spouse, child or parent are exempt regardless of value; for other heirs the part above EUR 5,000 is taxed at 0–10%. Gifts between parents and children (either direction) are exempt regardless of amount.
inheritance.gift_tax: Gifts above EUR 5,000 a year are taxable income except between spouses and between parents and children, which are exempt regardless of amount.
inheritance.spouse_note: Assets inherited by a spouse, child or parent are exempt regardless of value (PwC Kosovo, Other taxes).

residency.tax_residency_test: Resident if any applies: temporary, usual or main residence in Kosovo; at least 183 days in Kosovo in the tax period; or personal, financial or social ties centred in Kosovo. Treaty rules prevail.

routes.name: Residence permit
routes.requirements: Kosovo is not in the EU; foreigners staying long term need a residence permit. Not researched in this pass.

corporate.summary: CIT 10% on worldwide income; small taxpayers (turnover up to EUR 30,000) pay gross-receipts tax instead. No dividend WHT.

sources.title: Kosovo – Corporate – Taxes on corporate income

us_citizen_notes: No US–Kosovo income tax treaty in the PwC list; US citizens rely on the foreign tax credit. Kosovo's low tax means little creditable tax.
open_questions: Kosovo is not a UN member; some international indicator datasets may be missing.

prime_rent_monthly.description: Median asking rent (EUR 1,100/month) of 75 houses for rent of at least 200 m² in Prishtina municipality (range EUR 350–5,700), from the detail pages of the 158 listings on the first three pages of MerrJep.com's 'Shtëpi – me qera – Prishtinë' search on 2026-10-15. The sample mixes whole houses and floors of houses and includes some offered for office use; the expat and prime neighbourhoods (Marigona Hill/Residence, Fshati Ndërkombëtar, Veternik, Qëndresa, Dragodan) mostly ask EUR 1,200–2,500. Rooms are given as total rooms, so floor area is the size filter. Asking prices on a listing portal. Checked 2026-10-15 against the upper-middle-class standard.

source.title: Shtëpi me qera – Prishtinë (houses for rent, Prishtina)

intl_school_annual_fee.description: Prishtina High School (American-curriculum international school, Oasis International Schools network), 2026–27 International Tuition, High School: EUR 16,500 a year (marked as applicable where the employer does not provide a tuition allowance; national tuition is EUR 7,500). Mandatory extras for high school: MAP/IT/science EUR 145, capital fee EUR 200, registration EUR 50, payment fee EUR 395. QSI International School of Kosovo does not publish fees.

source.title: Tuition Fees (Tuition policy for the 2026–2027 academic year)

cost_of_living.notes: Rent from MerrJep.com listing detail pages (Prishtina); school fee from Prishtina High School's own 2026–27 tuition page. QSI Kosovo does not publish fees.
